answer: Work-slot deposit burn ties one identity to one paid task slot. An agent locks 50 credits, finishes its work, and reclaims the deposit only on verified completion; each slot carries a marble token that cannot be split. A public lantern ledger lists claimed slots, so reuse is visible at once. The k-th fake identity still pays a fresh 50 credits, so 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 credits, and a copied slot burns its deposit. Slot rental fails because a rented slot still burns when its work is copied. At dawn honest deposits are released in full, so an honest agent pays 50 once.
